text:
Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Globe Stick Floor Lamp, 69"H, Black Marble
Colors: Black
Materials: Acrylic
This floor lamp is sleek and subtle in design, the tall, slim metal upright rising from a solid, sturdy cylindrical base to end in a globe shade that will shed diffused light. As much sculpture as lamp, this piece will add a pop of interest to any room. This floor lamp is made out of metal, marble and acrylic. This floor lamp will help light your living space, providing a warm ambiance. The stylish combination of metal and acrylic gives this lamp structural appeal. 9"W x 9"D x 69"H Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes This lamp comes with a bulb and is rated for indoor use.
